CustomField.label: Lead Reference Number
CustomField.formula: CASE(TEXT(Lead_Vendor__c), "AEM", "AEM", "Klover", "KLV", "Mike's Leads", "MIKE", "Other", "OTH", "UNK") & "_" & CASE(TEXT(Lead_Vendor_Type__c), "AP", "AP", "Packs", "PK", "Legal", "LG", "Inbound Lead", "IN", "Dialer", "DL", "Digiapps", "DA", "Webform", "WF", "Lexicon", "LX", "NA") & "_" & TEXT(YEAR(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate))) & RIGHT("0" & TEXT(MONTH(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate))), 2) & RIGHT("0" & TEXT(DAY(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate))), 2) & "_" & RIGHT(Id, 6)
